نحسس (form I)
# نَحْسُسْ (naḥsus) /naħ.sus/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”)
# نُحْسَسْ (nuḥsas) /nuħ.sas/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to freeze; to curry (a horse)”) and حَسَّ (ḥassa, “to feel, to perceive”)
# نَحْسِسْ (naḥsis) /naħ.sis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of حَسَّ (ḥassa, “
